response.sql: WITH linked_fees AS (SELECT o.orderbase, f.feerate FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(feerate) AS rate FROM linked_fees), channel_rates AS (SELECT orderbase, AVG(feerate) AS rate FROM linked_fees WHERE orderbase IS NOT NULL GROUP BY orderbase) SELECT AVG(c.rate) AS mean_channel_fee_rate, AVG(c.rate - b.rate) AS mean_excess_fee_rate FROM channel_rates AS c CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE c.rate > b.rate

assumptions.assumption: A NULL orderbase does not identify a channel; its linked fee records still count toward the overall benchmark.
